item.title: CiteSpace Bibliometric Visualization
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: Learned to use CiteSpace for bibliometric visualization. This post also briefly introduces some other web-based visualization tools, but the focus is CiteSpace. Written to record points the online tutorials leave out (for the new 6.2.2 version) and some finer operational details.
